title: The garage, v
venue: Arthur's site (newspaper cadence: six dailies + a Sunday)
logline: Saturday. Gully finds the place. Brings a plant. The plant dies by June; the strip never mentions it again. The tavern's back door, the garage's door, six feet apart.

panels.composition: The alley behind the tavern. GULLY in the apron with a potted plant, looking at two doors six feet apart: the tavern's back door with a bare bulb, and the garage's.

characters.pose: with a plant, choosing a door

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, a man in an apron holding a potted plant in an alley looking between a tavern's back door with a bare bulb and a garage's door six feet away

panels.composition: Gully in the garage doorway. WOOD at the table. BARNABY greeting the plant.

balloons.text: I live behind a garage door. The bar's a coincidence.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, a man in an apron standing in a garage doorway holding a plant, a thin man at a drafting table, a small dog sniffing the plant

panels.composition: Gully setting the plant on the sill beside the jar. Looking at the corkboard. Finding himself on it — the 1998 flyer.

balloons.text: That's my flyer. Your uncle paid twenty.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, a man in an apron setting a plant on a windowsill beside a jar and noticing an old flyer on a corkboard

panels.composition: The garage, whole, for the first time: the table, the sill with a jar and a plant, the corkboard, the dog, the two men, the jukebox shape faint in the wall. Home, unnamed.
